reason: A browser-side Cyberpunk 2077 theme for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI, primarily providing visual styling, optional animations, synthesized sound effects, and configurable presentation effects.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 提供赛博朋克 2077 风格的配色、布局、动画和可选合成音效主题。
summaries.en: Adds a Cyberpunk 2077-inspired theme to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with configurable colors, layout styling, animations, and synthesized sound effects.

capabilities: Modifies the DeepSeek Harness Web UI appearance and layout
Adds client-side animations, visual effects, and synthesized audio feedback
Stores user effect preferences in browser localStorage
